verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring filings, such as periodic VAT pre-returns, is a fair question for a tax-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduling or recurring-job capability. MeinELSTER+ 'automatische Erstellung' is automated pre-filling of an annual return, not a user-defined recurring schedule. Third-party tax software connecting through ELSTER is an external workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
